title: Choose LendLoop's visual world
question: The roll assigned Paint Chip Rack. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Paint Chip Rack
options.thesis: Every tool is a named chip on the neighborhood's swatch rack; each category is a colour family.
options.viewport: Seven live swatch strips fan across the page, one per category, each chip a real listed tool; the tagline sits on the white card stock and 'Sign in to borrow' is the strip's punched tab.
options.risk: Can read as a paint shop if tool names are set smaller than the colour.

raised.raise: Loan status is a screen pull: each stage adds one flat colour layer to the chip, and calm states strip back to two inks.
Every date sits on one strict day grid; borrow ranges are measured against it, never floated.
Loan history is append-only: each reminder and notification leaves a permanent printed mark on the back of the chip.

options.label: Due-Date Card
options.lineage: library book pocket and date-due stamp
options.thesis: Every loan is a library card: stamped out, stamped due, stamped back.
materials: rubber date stamps in violet ink
options.viewport: A giant card pocket holds the tagline typed on its card; the public tool list runs as ruled rows with stamped dates.
options.risk: The most familiar direction for anything about borrowing, and it sits close to the cream-and-nostalgia default.

options.label: Block-Party Flyer Wall
options.lineage: screenprinted street-fair flyers pasted on a hoarding
options.thesis: LendLoop is the loudest flyer on the street; one calm white ticket panel is where you find a tool.
options.viewport: A full-bleed collage with LENDLOOP set one colour per letter; a white ticket panel floats on it with category and dates as the working finder.
options.case: Strongest street-level identity of the hand; loses on clarity, because the collage fights the tool list and the dashboard has to calm right down.
options.risk: Loud enough that the signed-in app may feel like a different product.

options.label: Solidarity Silkscreen
options.thesis: One emblem, flat fearless colour, a slogan border.
options.viewport: Central emblem framed by a repeating slogan.
options.case: Political-poster register overstates a tool-lending app.
options.risk: Reads as a cause, not a service.
options.kept: State as a screen pull: one flat colour layer per loan stage.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.thesis: Loans as signals on a graticule.
options.viewport: A trace per loan across a ten-division grid.
options.case: Neighbors don't identify with lab instruments.
options.kept: Everything measured on one strict grid: the day grid for bookings.

options.label: Floated Pigment
options.thesis: Every action permanently displaces the colour around it.
options.viewport: A marbled bath you comb to browse.
options.case: Beautiful but unrelated to tools or neighbors.
options.kept: Irreversible marks: loan history is append-only and visible.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.viewport: A column of struts with annotated nodes.
options.case: The lender/borrower metaphor is too abstract to read.
options.kept: Annotations pinned to the thing they describe.

options.label: Curved Crease
options.thesis: One arc governs the whole sheet.
options.viewport: A folded disc with plate-numbered figures.
options.case: Quiet and precise but says nothing about lending.
options.kept: One governing line rather than a grid of equal boxes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A friendly community marketplace, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Search bar hero over a grid of tool cards with photos and availability badges.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every neighborhood or rental app by design.
